contexts.text: Where it treats of the Postdiluvians such words are employed as do not so much regard the will as the understanding; for... the Postdiluvians had good from truth.
There was not celestial but spiritual seed in the Postdiluvians...
The Lord induced other states on the Postdiluvians.

The postdiluvian man is such that he can retain all his own life, and perceive it as his own, although it is not his life and perception, but appears as his, differently from those who were before the Flood. Explained.
